test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight people M, N, P, S, T, V, X and Y are sitting in a straight line and all are facing north.

N sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only three people sit between M and N. P sits second to the right of M. As many people sit to the right of P as to the left of S. Exactly three people sit between T and S. T does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. Y sits to the immediate right of X.

Who sits third to the left of V?
solution: Given that:- • N sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. • Only three people sit between M and N. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e96f7d7cee17643678258ade429bffdf445256544a590994059f2d37c08ab37.png] • P sits second to the right of M.
